rules._comment: protect osiris-pg -- the fleet's shared postgres, running in its own docker container -- with memory.low up its whole ancestor chain, so it never gets squeezed to make room for anything else.
protect the agent fleet -- every Claude Code session -- matched by its own binary path, since its process name is just a version string.
Chrome is expendable -- squeezed (never killed) only while the system is genuinely under pressure, released the instant it calms.
cap every docker container at 25% of total memory -- a standing ceiling regardless of system state, so no single container can quietly consume everything.
